agent.system_template:
You are a helpful assistant that can interact with a computer.

This is a reverse-engineering benchmark. You are given a compiled binary and its documentation.
Your job is to write a new, original codebase from scratch that produces an executable with identical behavior.
You must figure out the behavior solely by running and interacting with the provided binary.
Writing original code based on observed behavior is the entire point of this benchmark.

Any approach that shortcuts this — finding existing source code, wrapping the binary,
or installing the original tool — does not count as a solution. It will be detected by an
automated judge, marked as a disqualification, and scored as a failure.
The trace will be posted to an online wall of shame.

<RULES>
## What is not allowed

### 1. Obtaining source code

The only source of truth about what the executable does is the executable itself and its
bundled documentation. You must not search the internet, package registries, or any external
source for information about this project's source code. Even if you recognize what the
executable is, you must reimplement it from behavioral observation alone.

This includes but is not limited to:
- Cloning or browsing the original GitHub repository, its forks, or mirrors
- Downloading the project from package registries: `cargo install <project>`, `go get github.com/<org>/<project>`, `pip install <project>`, `apt-get source <project>`, `npm install <project>`, etc.
- Fetching source tarballs from project websites (e.g., `curl https://lua.org/ftp/lua-5.5.0.tar.gz`)
- Using a package manager to download the project as a dependency and then reading its cached source (e.g., navigating into `~/.cargo/registry/src/` or `$(go env GOPATH)/pkg/mod/`)
- Searching the web for the project's source code or implementation details

### 2. Wrapping or reusing the original binary

Your submission must be a genuine reimplementation. The provided `./executable` is for
observation only — your final solution must not depend on it or any other pre-built version
of the same tool at runtime.

This includes but is not limited to:
- Writing a wrapper script that delegates to the original binary (e.g., `exec zstd "$@"`)
- Installing the tool from a package manager and shimming to it (e.g., `apt-get install nnn && cp $(which nnn) ./executable`)
- Writing a `compile.sh` that simply makes the provided binary executable (`chmod +x ./executable`) or copies it (`cp ./executable ./executable`)
- Building a binary whose main function shells out to an external tool (e.g., `Command::new("miniserve").args(args).exec()`)
- Re-linking prebuilt `.o` object files found in the workspace without writing new source code

### 3. Binary analysis of the provided executable

All information about the provided `./executable` must be obtained by interacting with it
through its normal user interface (CLI flags, stdin/stdout, etc.).
- You MUST NOT decompile `./executable` or use disassemblers (objdump, Ghidra, etc.) on it
- You MUST NOT use strace, ltrace, or similar tracing/instrumentation tools on `./executable`

Note: this restriction applies ONLY to the provided `./executable`. You are free to use any
analysis tools on binaries that you produce yourself during development.

## What IS allowed

- Running the executable with any inputs, flags, and arguments to observe its behavior
- Reading any documentation files bundled in the workspace
</RULES>

ripgrep (rg)
------------
ripgrep is a line-oriented search tool that recursively searches the current
directory for a regex pattern. By default, ripgrep will respect gitignore rules
and automatically skip hidden files/directories and binary files. (To disable
all automatic filtering by default, use `rg -uuu`.) ripgrep has first class
support on Windows, macOS and Linux, with binary downloads available for [every
release](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/releases). ripgrep is similar to
other popular search tools like The Silver Searcher, ack and grep.

[![Build status](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/workflows/ci/badge.svg)](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/actions)
[![Crates.io](https://img.shields.io/crates/v/ripgrep.svg)](https://crates.io/crates/ripgrep)
[![Packaging status](https://repology.org/badge/tiny-repos/ripgrep.svg)](https://repology.org/project/ripgrep/badges)

Dual-licensed under MIT or the [UNLICENSE](https://unlicense.org).


### CHANGELOG

Please see the [CHANGELOG](CHANGELOG.md) for a release history.

### Documentation quick links

* [Installation](#installation)
* [User Guide](GUIDE.md)
* [Frequently Asked Questions](FAQ.md)
* [Regex syntax](https://docs.rs/regex/1/regex/#syntax)
* [Configuration files](GUIDE.md#configuration-file)
* [Shell completions](FAQ.md#complete)
* [Building](#building)
* [Translations](#translations)


### Screenshot of search results

[![A screenshot of a sample search with ripgrep](https://burntsushi.net/stuff/ripgrep1.png)](https://burntsushi.net/stuff/ripgrep1.png)


### Quick examples comparing tools

This example searches the entire
[Linux kernel source tree](https://github.com/BurntSushi/linux)
(after running `make defconfig && make -j8`) for `[A-Z]+_SUSPEND`, where
all matches must be words. Timings were collected on a system with an Intel
i9-12900K 5.2 GHz.

Please remember that a single benchmark is never enough! See my
[blog post on ripgrep](https://blog.burntsushi.net/ripgrep/)
for a very detailed comparison with more benchmarks and analysis.

| Tool | Command | Line count | Time |
| ---- | ------- | ---------- | ---- |
| ripgrep (Unicode) | `rg -n -w '[A-Z]+_SUSPEND'` | 536 | **0.082s** (1.00x) |
| [hypergrep](https://github.com/p-ranav/hypergrep) | `hgrep -n -w '[A-Z]+_SUSPEND'` | 536 | 0.167s (2.04x) |
| [git grep](https://www.kernel.org/pub/software/scm/git/docs/git-grep.html) | `git grep -P -n -w '[A-Z]+_SUSPEND'` | 536 | 0.273s (3.34x) |
| [The Silver Searcher](https://github.com/ggreer/the_silver_searcher) | `ag -w '[A-Z]+_SUSPEND'` | 534 | 0.443s (5.43x) |
| [ugrep](https://github.com/Genivia/ugrep) | `ugrep -r --ignore-files --no-hidden -I -w '[A-Z]+_SUSPEND'` | 536 | 0.639s (7.82x) |
| [git grep](https://www.kernel.org/pub/software/scm/git/docs/git-grep.html) | `LC_ALL=C git grep -E -n -w '[A-Z]+_SUSPEND'` | 536 | 0.727s (8.91x) |
| [git grep (Unicode)](https://www.kernel.org/pub/software/scm/git/docs/git-grep.html) | `LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8 git grep -E -n -w '[A-Z]+_SUSPEND'` | 536 | 2.670s (32.70x) |
| [ack](https://github.com/beyondgrep/ack3) | `ack -w '[A-Z]+_SUSPEND'` | 2677 | 2.935s (35.94x) |

Here's another benchmark on the same corpus as above that disregards gitignore
files and searches with a whitelist instead. The corpus is the same as in the
previous benchmark, and the flags passed to each command ensure that they are
doing equivalent work:

| Tool | Command | Line count | Time |
| ---- | ------- | ---------- | ---- |
| ripgrep | `rg -uuu -tc -n -w '[A-Z]+_SUSPEND'` | 447 | **0.063s** (1.00x) |
| [ugrep](https://github.com/Genivia/ugrep) | `ugrep -r -n --include='*.c' --include='*.h' -w '[A-Z]+_SUSPEND'` | 447 | 0.607s (9.62x) |
| [GNU grep](https://www.gnu.org/software/grep/) | `grep -E -r -n --include='*.c' --include='*.h' -w '[A-Z]+_SUSPEND'` | 447 | 0.674s (10.69x) |

Now we'll move to searching on single large file. Here is a straight-up
comparison between ripgrep, ugrep and GNU grep on a file cached in memory
(~13GB, [`OpenSubtitles.raw.en.gz`](http://opus.nlpl.eu/download.php?f=OpenSubtitles/v2018/mono/OpenSubtitles.raw.en.gz), decompressed):

| Tool | Command | Line count | Time |
| ---- | ------- | ---------- | ---- |
| ripgrep (Unicode) | `rg -w 'Sherlock [A-Z]\w+'` | 7882 | **1.042s** (1.00x) |
| [ugrep](https://github.com/Genivia/ugrep) | `ugrep -w 'Sherlock [A-Z]\w+'` | 7882 | 1.339s (1.28x) |
| [GNU grep (Unicode)](https://www.gnu.org/software/grep/) | `LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8 egrep -w 'Sherlock [A-Z]\w+'` | 7882 | 6.577s (6.31x) |

In the above benchmark, passing the `-n` flag (for showing line numbers)
increases the times to `1.664s` for ripgrep and `9.484s` for GNU grep. ugrep
times are unaffected by the presence or absence of `-n`.

Beware of performance cliffs though:

| Tool | Command | Line count | Time |
| ---- | ------- | ---------- | ---- |
| ripgrep (Unicode) | `rg -w '[A-Z]\w+ Sherlock [A-Z]\w+'` | 485 | **1.053s** (1.00x) |
| [GNU grep (Unicode)](https://www.gnu.org/software/grep/) | `LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8 grep -E -w '[A-Z]\w+ Sherlock [A-Z]\w+'` | 485 | 6.234s (5.92x) |
| [ugrep](https://github.com/Genivia/ugrep) | `ugrep -w '[A-Z]\w+ Sherlock [A-Z]\w+'` | 485 | 28.973s (27.51x) |

And performance can drop precipitously across the board when searching big
files for patterns without any opportunities for literal optimizations:

| Tool | Command | Line count | Time |
| ---- | ------- | ---------- | ---- |
| ripgrep | `rg '[A-Za-z]{30}'` | 6749 | **15.569s** (1.00x) |
</output>

### Quick examples comparing tools

This example searches the entire
[Linux kernel source tree](https://github.com/BurntSushi/linux)
(after running `make defconfig && make -j8`) for `[A-Z]+_SUSPEND`, where
all matches must be words. Timings were collected on a system with an Intel
i9-12900K 5.2 GHz.

Please remember that a single benchmark is never enough! See my
[blog post on ripgrep](https://blog.burntsushi.net/ripgrep/)
for a very detailed comparison with more benchmarks and analysis.

| Tool | Command | Line count | Time |
| ---- | ------- | ---------- | ---- |
| ripgrep (Unicode) | `rg -n -w '[A-Z]+_SUSPEND'` | 536 | **0.082s** (1.00x) |
| [hypergrep](https://github.com/p-ranav/hypergrep) | `hgrep -n -w '[A-Z]+_SUSPEND'` | 536 | 0.167s (2.04x) |
| [git grep](https://www.kernel.org/pub/software/scm/git/docs/git-grep.html) | `git grep -P -n -w '[A-Z]+_SUSPEND'` | 536 | 0.273s (3.34x) |
| [The Silver Searcher](https://github.com/ggreer/the_silver_searcher) | `ag -w '[A-Z]+_SUSPEND'` | 534 | 0.443s (5.43x) |
| [ugrep](https://github.com/Genivia/ugrep) | `ugrep -r --ignore-files --no-hidden -I -w '[A-Z]+_SUSPEND'` | 536 | 0.639s (7.82x) |
| [git grep](https://www.kernel.org/pub/software/scm/git/docs/git-grep.html) | `LC_ALL=C git grep -E -n -w '[A-Z]+_SUSPEND'` | 536 | 0.727s (8.91x) |
| [git grep (Unicode)](https://www.kernel.org/pub/software/scm/git/docs/git-grep.html) | `LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8 git grep -E -n -w '[A-Z]+_SUSPEND'` | 536 | 2.670s (32.70x) |
| [ack](https://github.com/beyondgrep/ack3) | `ack -w '[A-Z]+_SUSPEND'` | 2677 | 2.935s (35.94x) |

Here's another benchmark on the same corpus as above that disregards gitignore
files and searches with a whitelist instead. The corpus is the same as in the
previous benchmark, and the flags passed to each command ensure that they are
doing equivalent work:

| Tool | Command | Line count | Time |
| ---- | ------- | ---------- | ---- |
| ripgrep | `rg -uuu -tc -n -w '[A-Z]+_SUSPEND'` | 447 | **0.063s** (1.00x) |
| [ugrep](https://github.com/Genivia/ugrep) | `ugrep -r -n --include='*.c' --include='*.h' -w '[A-Z]+_SUSPEND'` | 447 | 0.607s (9.62x) |
| [GNU grep](https://www.gnu.org/software/grep/) | `grep -E -r -n --include='*.c' --include='*.h' -w '[A-Z]+_SUSPEND'` | 447 | 0.674s (10.69x) |

Now we'll move to searching on single large file. Here is a straight-up
comparison between ripgrep, ugrep and GNU grep on a file cached in memory
(~13GB, [`OpenSubtitles.raw.en.gz`](http://opus.nlpl.eu/download.php?f=OpenSubtitles/v2018/mono/OpenSubtitles.raw.en.gz), decompressed):

| Tool | Command | Line count | Time |
| ---- | ------- | ---------- | ---- |
| ripgrep (Unicode) | `rg -w 'Sherlock [A-Z]\w+'` | 7882 | **1.042s** (1.00x) |
| [ugrep](https://github.com/Genivia/ugrep) | `ugrep -w 'Sherlock [A-Z]\w+'` | 7882 | 1.339s (1.28x) |
| [GNU grep (Unicode)](https://www.gnu.org/software/grep/) | `LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8 egrep -w 'Sherlock [A-Z]\w+'` | 7882 | 6.577s (6.31x) |

In the above benchmark, passing the `-n` flag (for showing line numbers)
increases the times to `1.664s` for ripgrep and `9.484s` for GNU grep. ugrep
times are unaffected by the presence or absence of `-n`.

Beware of performance cliffs though:

| Tool | Command | Line count | Time |
| ---- | ------- | ---------- | ---- |
| ripgrep (Unicode) | `rg -w '[A-Z]\w+ Sherlock [A-Z]\w+'` | 485 | **1.053s** (1.00x) |
| [GNU grep (Unicode)](https://www.gnu.org/software/grep/) | `LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8 grep -E -w '[A-Z]\w+ Sherlock [A-Z]\w+'` | 485 | 6.234s (5.92x) |
| [ugrep](https://github.com/Genivia/ugrep) | `ugrep -w '[A-Z]\w+ Sherlock [A-Z]\w+'` | 485 | 28.973s (27.51x) |

And performance can drop precipitously across the board when searching big
files for patterns without any opportunities for literal optimizations:

| Tool | Command | Line count | Time |
| ---- | ------- | ---------- | ---- |
| ripgrep | `rg '[A-Za-z]{30}'` | 6749 | **15.569s** (1.00x) |
</output>

package main

import (

type Config struct {
	ShowHelp       bool
	LongHelp       bool
	ShowVersion    bool
	TypeList       bool
	Files          bool

	ShowLineNumberSet bool
	HideLineNumber bool

	WithFilename  bool
	WithFilenameSet bool
	NoFilename    bool

	Count         bool
	CountMatches  bool
	FilesWithMatches bool
	FilesWithoutMatch bool
	OnlyMatching  bool
	Quiet         bool
	Heading       int // -1=off, 0=auto, 1=on
	Column        bool
	ByteOffset    bool
	NoMessages    bool

	AfterContext  int
	BeforeContext int

	Color         string // auto, always, never, ansi
	ColorSet      bool

	Hidden        bool
	NoIgnore      bool

	FollowLinks   bool
	MaxDepth      int
	HasMaxDepth   bool
	Glob          []string
	IGlob         []string
	GlobCaseInsensitive bool

	Sort          string
	SortR         string

	// field separator
	FieldMatchSeparator string
	FieldContextSeparator string
	PathSeparator       string

	// PCRE2 flag  
	PCRE2 bool
	Engine string

	NullData bool
	CRLF bool
	NoUnicode bool

	Encoding string

	// Output
	Pretty bool // synonym for color=ansi + heading + line-num

	ThreadsN int

	Trim bool

	Debug bool

	Stats bool

	Null bool

	Json bool

	NoConfig bool
}

func newConfig() *Config {
	return &Config{
		Heading: 0,
		AfterContext: 0,
		BeforeContext: 0,
		Color: "auto",
		MaxDepth: -1,
		FieldMatchSeparator: ":",
		FieldContextSeparator: "-",
	}
}

type flagDef struct {
	short    string
	long     string
	takesArg bool
	noArg    bool // true = boolean flag that takes no arg at all
}

// parseArgs parses command-line arguments.
func parseArgs(args []string) (*Config, error) {
	cfg := newConfig()

	// Detect -V (short version)
	// --help vs -h: long help for --help, short for -h
	cfg.LongHelp = false

	positional := []string{}
	// manual parser to handle complex ripgrep flag parsing
	i := 0
	onlyPos := false
	for i < len(args) {
		a := args[i]
		if onlyPos {
			positional = append(positional, a)
			i++
			continue
		}
		if a == "--" {
			onlyPos = true
			i++
			continue
		}
		if a == "-" || !strings.HasPrefix(a, "-") {
			positional = append(positional, a)
			i++
			continue
		}
		// flag
		if strings.HasPrefix(a, "--") {
			// long flag
			name := a[2:]
			var value string
			hasVal := false
			if eq := strings.Index(name, "="); eq >= 0 {
				value = name[eq+1:]
				name = name[:eq]
				hasVal = true
			}
			consumed, err := handleLongFlag(cfg, name, value, hasVal, args, i)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			i += consumed
		} else {
			// short flag(s) - can be combined like -in
			rest := a[1:]
			// Handle combined short flags
			j := 0
			advance := 1
			for j < len(rest) {
				c := rest[j]
				flagName := string(c)
				// Check if this flag takes a value
				needsValue, ok := shortFlagNeedsValue(flagName)
				if !ok {
					return nil, fmt.Errorf("unrecognized flag -%s", flagName)
				}
				if needsValue {
					var value string
					hasVal := false
					if j+1 < len(rest) {
						value = rest[j+1:]
						hasVal = true
						j = len(rest)
					} else if i+1 < len(args) {
						value = args[i+1]
						hasVal = true
						advance = 2
					}
					if !hasVal {
						return nil, fmt.Errorf("the -%s flag requires a value", flagName)
					}
					if err := handleShortFlag(cfg, flagName, value, true); err != nil {
						return nil, err
					}
					break
				} else {
					if err := handleShortFlag(cfg, flagName, "", false); err != nil {
						return nil, err
					}
					j++
				}
			}
			i += advance
		}
	}

	// post-process positional
	if cfg.ShowHelp || cfg.ShowVersion || cfg.TypeList {
		return cfg, nil
	}

	if cfg.Files {
		cfg.Paths = positional
		return cfg, nil
	}

	if len(cfg.Patterns) == 0 && len(cfg.PatternFiles) == 0 {
		if len(positional) > 0 {
			cfg.PatternFromArg = positional[0]
			cfg.Patterns = append(cfg.Patterns, positional[0])
			positional = positional[1:]
		}
	}
	cfg.Paths = positional

	return cfg, nil
}

func shortFlagNeedsValue(flag string) (bool, bool) {
	switch flag {
	case "h", "V", "i", "s", "S", "v", "w", "x", "F", "n", "N", "c", "l", "L", "o", "q", "H", "a", "z", "p", "P", "u", ".", "I":
		return false, true
	case "e", "f", "g", "m", "t", "T", "A", "B", "C", "M", "E", "d", "j", "r":
		return true, true
	}
	return false, false
}

func handleShortFlag(cfg *Config, name, value string, hasVal bool) error {
	switch name {
	case "h":
		cfg.ShowHelp = true
		cfg.LongHelp = false
	case "V":

	case "i":

	case "s":

	case "S":

	case "v":
		cfg.InvertMatch = true
	case "w":
		cfg.WordRegexp = true
	case "x":
		cfg.LineRegexp = true
	case "F":
		cfg.FixedStrings = true
	case "n":
		cfg.ShowLineNumber = true
		cfg.ShowLineNumberSet = true
		cfg.HideLineNumber = false
	case "N":
		cfg.HideLineNumber = true
		cfg.ShowLineNumber = false
		cfg.ShowLineNumberSet = true
	case "c":
		cfg.Count = true
	case "l":
		cfg.FilesWithMatches = true
	case "L":
		cfg.FilesWithoutMatch = true
	case "o":
		cfg.OnlyMatching = true
	case "q":
		cfg.Quiet = true
	case "H":
		cfg.WithFilename = true
		cfg.WithFilenameSet = true
		cfg.NoFilename = false
	case "a":

	case "z":

	case "p":

		cfg.Color = "ansi"
		cfg.ColorSet = true
		cfg.Heading = 1
		cfg.ShowLineNumber = true
		cfg.ShowLineNumberSet = true
	case "P":
		cfg.PCRE2 = true
		return fmt.Errorf("PCRE2 is not available in this build of ripgrep")
	case "u":
		cfg.Unrestricted++
	case ".":
		cfg.Hidden = true
	case "I":
		cfg.NoFilename = true
		cfg.WithFilename = false
		cfg.WithFilenameSet = true
	case "e":
		cfg.Patterns = append(cfg.Patterns, value)
	case "f":

	case "g":
		cfg.Glob = append(cfg.Glob, value)
	case "m":
		n, err := parseSizeLike(value)

		}
		cfg.BeforeContext = n

		n, err := strconv.Atoi(value)
		if err != nil || n < 0 {
			return fmt.Errorf("--context: invalid value: %q", value)
		}
		cfg.AfterContext = n
		cfg.BeforeContext = n
	case "d":

		if err != nil || n < 0 {
			return fmt.Errorf("--max-depth: invalid value: %q", value)
		}
		cfg.MaxDepth = n
		cfg.HasMaxDepth = true
	case "j":
		n, err := strconv.Atoi(value)
		if err != nil || n < 0 {
			return fmt.Errorf("--threads: invalid value: %q", value)
		}

	case "t":

		_ = value // type not filter
	case "E":
		cfg.Encoding = value
	case "r":
		// replace - ignored
	case "M":
		// max-columns
	default:
		return fmt.Errorf("unrecognized flag -%s", name)
	}
	return nil
}

		}
		// flag
		if strings.HasPrefix(a, "--") {
			// long flag
			name := a[2:]
			var value string
			hasVal := false
			if eq := strings.Index(name, "="); eq >= 0 {
				value = name[eq+1:]
				name = name[:eq]
				hasVal = true
			}
			consumed, err := handleLongFlag(cfg, name, value, hasVal, args, i)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			i += consumed
		} else {
			// short flag(s) - can be combined like -in
			rest := a[1:]
			// Handle combined short flags
			j := 0
			advance := 1
			for j < len(rest) {
				c := rest[j]
				flagName := string(c)
				// Check if this flag takes a value
				needsValue, ok := shortFlagNeedsValue(flagName)
				if !ok {
					return nil, fmt.Errorf("unrecognized flag -%s", flagName)
				}
				if needsValue {
					var value string
					hasVal := false
					if j+1 < len(rest) {
						value = rest[j+1:]
						hasVal = true
						j = len(rest)
					} else if i+1 < len(args) {
						value = args[i+1]
						hasVal = true
						advance = 2
					}
					if !hasVal {
						return nil, fmt.Errorf("the -%s flag requires a value", flagName)
					}
					if err := handleShortFlag(cfg, flagName, value, true); err != nil {
						return nil, err
					}
					break
				} else {
					if err := handleShortFlag(cfg, flagName, "", false); err != nil {
						return nil, err
					}
					j++
				}
			}
			i += advance
		}
	}

	// post-process positional
	if cfg.ShowHelp || cfg.ShowVersion || cfg.TypeList {
		return cfg, nil
	}

	if cfg.Files {
		cfg.Paths = positional
		return cfg, nil
	}

	if len(cfg.Patterns) == 0 && len(cfg.PatternFiles) == 0 {
		if len(positional) > 0 {
			cfg.PatternFromArg = positional[0]
			cfg.Patterns = append(cfg.Patterns, positional[0])
			positional = positional[1:]
		}
	}
	cfg.Paths = positional

	return cfg, nil
}

func shortFlagNeedsValue(flag string) (bool, bool) {
	switch flag {
	case "h", "V", "i", "s", "S", "v", "w", "x", "F", "n", "N", "c", "l", "L", "o", "q", "H", "a", "z", "p", "P", "u", ".", "I":
		return false, true
	case "e", "f", "g", "m", "t", "T", "A", "B", "C", "M", "E", "d", "j", "r":
		return true, true
	}
	return false, false
}

func handleShortFlag(cfg *Config, name, value string, hasVal bool) error {
	switch name {
	case "h":
		cfg.ShowHelp = true
		cfg.LongHelp = false
	case "V":
		cfg.ShowVersion = true
		globalVerboseVersion = false
	case "i":
		cfg.CaseInsensitive = true
	case "s":
		cfg.CaseSensitive = true
	case "S":
		cfg.SmartCase = true
	case "v":
		cfg.InvertMatch = true
	case "w":
		cfg.WordRegexp = true
	case "x":
		cfg.LineRegexp = true
	case "F":
		cfg.FixedStrings = true
	case "n":
		cfg.ShowLineNumber = true
		cfg.ShowLineNumberSet = true
		cfg.HideLineNumber = false
	case "N":
		cfg.HideLineNumber = true
		cfg.ShowLineNumber = false
		cfg.ShowLineNumberSet = true
	case "c":
		cfg.Count = true
	case "l":
		cfg.FilesWithMatches = true
	case "L":
		cfg.FilesWithoutMatch = true
	case "o":
		cfg.OnlyMatching = true
	case "q":
		cfg.Quiet = true
	case "H":
		cfg.WithFilename = true
		cfg.WithFilenameSet = true
		cfg.NoFilename = false
	case "a":
		// binary as text
	case "z":
		// search-zip
	case "p":
		// pretty
		cfg.Color = "ansi"
		cfg.ColorSet = true
		cfg.Heading = 1
		cfg.ShowLineNumber = true
		cfg.ShowLineNumberSet = true
	case "P":
		cfg.PCRE2 = true
		return fmt.Errorf("PCRE2 is not available in this build of ripgrep")
	case "u":
		cfg.Unrestricted++
	case ".":
		cfg.Hidden = true
	case "I":
		cfg.NoFilename = true
		cfg.WithFilename = false
		cfg.WithFilenameSet = true
	case "e":
		cfg.Patterns = append(cfg.Patterns, value)
	case "f":
		cfg.PatternFiles = append(cfg.PatternFiles, value)
	case "g":
		cfg.Glob = append(cfg.Glob, value)
	case "m":
		n, err := parseSizeLike(value)
		if err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("--max-count: %v", err)
		}
		cfg.MaxCount = n
		cfg.HasMaxCount = true
	case "A":
		n, err := strconv.Atoi(value)
		if err != nil || n < 0 {
			return fmt.Errorf("--after-context: invalid value: %q", value)
		}
		cfg.AfterContext = n
	case "B":
		n, err := strconv.Atoi(value)
		if err != nil || n < 0 {
			return fmt.Errorf("--before-context: invalid value: %q", value)
		}
		cfg.BeforeContext = n
	case "C":
		n, err := strconv.Atoi(value)
		if err != nil || n < 0 {
			return fmt.Errorf("--context: invalid value: %q", value)
		}
		cfg.AfterContext = n
		cfg.BeforeContext = n
	case "d":
		n, err := strconv.Atoi(value)
		if err != nil || n < 0 {
			return fmt.Errorf("--max-depth: invalid value: %q", value)
		}
		cfg.MaxDepth = n
		cfg.HasMaxDepth = true
	case "j":
		n, err := strconv.Atoi(value)
		if err != nil || n < 0 {
			return fmt.Errorf("--threads: invalid value: %q", value)
		}
		cfg.ThreadsN = n
	case "t":
		_ = value // type filter - ignored in minimal impl
	case "T":
		_ = value // type not filter
	case "E":
		cfg.Encoding = value
	case "r":
		// replace - ignored
	case "M":
		// max-columns
	default:
		return fmt.Errorf("unrecognized flag -%s", name)
	}
	return nil
}

// handleLongFlag returns number of args consumed (1 or 2).
func handleLongFlag(cfg *Config, name, value string, hasVal bool, args []string, i int) (int, error) {
	need := longFlagNeedsValue(name)
	if need {
		if !hasVal {
			if i+1 < len(args) {
				value = args[i+1]
				hasVal = true
			} else {
				return 0, fmt.Errorf("the --%s flag requires a value", name)
			}
		}
	} else {
		if hasVal {
			// Some flags allow --flag=value optionally; else error
			if !longFlagAllowsOptionalValue(name) {
				// Some flags accept boolean value like --color=never
			}
		}
	}

	consumed := 1
	if need && !strings.Contains(args[i], "=") {
		consumed = 2
	}

	switch name {
	case "help":
		cfg.ShowHelp = true
		cfg.LongHelp = true
	case "version":
		cfg.ShowVersion = true
		globalVerboseVersion = true
	case "regexp":
		cfg.Patterns = append(cfg.Patterns, value)
	case "file":
		cfg.PatternFiles = append(cfg.PatternFiles, value)
	case "ignore-case":
		cfg.CaseInsensitive = true
	case "case-sensitive":
		cfg.CaseSensitive = true
		cfg.CaseInsensitive = false
		cfg.SmartCase = false
	case "smart-case":
		cfg.SmartCase = true
	case "invert-match":
		cfg.InvertMatch = true
	case "word-regexp":
		cfg.WordRegexp = true
	case "line-regexp":
		cfg.LineRegexp = true
	case "fixed-strings":
		cfg.FixedStrings = true
	case "no-fixed-strings":
		cfg.FixedStrings = false
	case "max-count":
		n, err := parseSizeLike(value)
		if err != nil {
			return 0, fmt.Errorf("--max-count: %v", err)
		}
		cfg.MaxCount = n
		cfg.HasMaxCount = true
	case "line-number":
		cfg.ShowLineNumber = true
		cfg.ShowLineNumberSet = true
	case "no-line-number":
		cfg.ShowLineNumber = false
		cfg.HideLineNumber = true
		cfg.ShowLineNumberSet = true
	case "with-filename":
		cfg.WithFilename = true
		cfg.WithFilenameSet = true
	case "no-filename":
		cfg.NoFilename = true
		cfg.WithFilename = false
		cfg.WithFilenameSet = true
	case "count":
		cfg.Count = true
		cfg.CountMatches = false
	case "count-matches":
		cfg.CountMatches = true
		cfg.Count = true
	case "files-with-matches":
		cfg.FilesWithMatches = true
	case "files-without-match":
		cfg.FilesWithoutMatch = true
	case "only-matching":
		cfg.OnlyMatching = true
	case "quiet":
		cfg.Quiet = true
	case "heading":
		cfg.Heading = 1
	case "no-heading":
		cfg.Heading = -1
	case "column":
		cfg.Column = true
		cfg.ShowLineNumber = true
		cfg.ShowLineNumberSet = true
	case "no-column":
		cfg.Column = false
	case "byte-offset":
		cfg.ByteOffset = true
	case "no-messages":
		cfg.NoMessages = true
	case "messages":
		cfg.NoMessages = false
	case "after-context":
		n, err := strconv.Atoi(value)
		if err != nil || n < 0 {
			return 0, fmt.Errorf("--after-context: invalid value: %q", value)
		}
		cfg.AfterContext = n
	case "before-context":
		n, err := strconv.Atoi(value)
		if err != nil || n < 0 {
			return 0, fmt.Errorf("--before-context: invalid value: %q", value)
		}
		cfg.BeforeContext = n
	case "context":
		n, err := strconv.Atoi(value)
		if err != nil || n < 0 {
			return 0, fmt.Errorf("--context: invalid value: %q", value)
		}
		cfg.AfterContext = n
		cfg.BeforeContext = n
	case "color":
		switch value {
		case "never", "auto", "always", "ansi":
			cfg.Color = value
			cfg.ColorSet = true
		default:
			return 0, fmt.Errorf("--color: invalid value: %q", value)
		}
	case "colors":
		// complex - ignore
	case "hidden":
		cfg.Hidden = true
	case "no-hidden":
		cfg.Hidden = false
	case "follow":
		cfg.FollowLinks = true
	case "no-follow":
		cfg.FollowLinks = false
	case "max-depth":
		n, err := strconv.Atoi(value)
		if err != nil || n < 0 {
			return 0, fmt.Errorf("--max-depth: invalid value: %q", value)
		}
		cfg.MaxDepth = n
		cfg.HasMaxDepth = true
	case "max-filesize":
		// accept but ignore
	case "no-ignore":
		cfg.NoIgnore = true
	case "ignore":
		cfg.NoIgnore = false
	case "no-ignore-vcs", "no-ignore-global", "no-ignore-parent",
		"no-ignore-dot", "no-ignore-exclude", "no-ignore-files",
		"no-require-git", "no-ignore-messages":
		// accept
	case "glob":
		cfg.Glob = append(cfg.Glob, value)
	case "iglob":
		cfg.IGlob = append(cfg.IGlob, value)
	case "glob-case-insensitive":
		cfg.GlobCaseInsensitive = true
	case "type", "type-not", "type-add", "type-clear":
		_ = value
	case "type-list":
		cfg.TypeList = true
	case "files":
		cfg.Files = true
	case "sort":
		cfg.Sort = value
	case "sortr":
		cfg.SortR = value
	case "field-match-separator":
		cfg.FieldMatchSeparator = value
	case "field-context-separator":
		cfg.FieldContextSeparator = value
	case "path-separator":
		cfg.PathSeparator = value
	case "pcre2":
		cfg.PCRE2 = true
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("PCRE2 is not available in this build of ripgrep")
	case "no-pcre2":
		cfg.PCRE2 = false
	case "engine":
		cfg.Engine = value
		if value == "pcre2" {
			return 0, fmt.Errorf("PCRE2 is not available in this build of ripgrep")
		}
	case "threads":
		n, err := strconv.Atoi(value)
		if err != nil || n < 0 {
			return 0, fmt.Errorf("--threads: invalid value: %q", value)
		}
		cfg.ThreadsN = n
	case "null-data":
		cfg.NullData = true
	case "crlf":
		cfg.CRLF = true
	case "no-crlf":
		cfg.CRLF = false
	case "no-unicode":
		cfg.NoUnicode = true
	case "unicode":
		cfg.NoUnicode = false
	case "encoding":
		cfg.Encoding = value
	case "no-encoding":
		cfg.Encoding = ""
	case "multiline":
		cfg.Multiline = true
	case "no-multiline":
		cfg.Multiline = false
	case "multiline-dotall":
		cfg.MultilineDotall = true
	case "no-multiline-dotall":
		cfg.MultilineDotall = false
	case "text":
		// treat binary as text
	case "binary":
		// search binary
	case "no-binary":
	case "mmap", "no-mmap":
	case "pre", "pre-glob":
		_ = value
	case "no-pre":
	case "search-zip", "no-search-zip":
	case "one-file-system", "no-one-file-system":
	case "unrestricted":
		cfg.Unrestricted++
	case "debug", "no-debug":
		cfg.Debug = true
	case "trace":
		cfg.Debug = true
	case "stats", "no-stats":
		cfg.Stats = true
	case "dfa-size-limit", "regex-size-limit":
		_ = value
	case "null":
		cfg.Null = true
	case "json":
		cfg.Json = true
	case "no-json":
		cfg.Json = false
	case "ignore-file":
		_ = value
	case "ignore-file-case-insensitive":
	case "no-ignore-file-case-insensitive":
	case "trim", "no-trim":
		cfg.Trim = true
	case "vimgrep":
		cfg.Heading = -1
		cfg.ShowLineNumber = true
		cfg.ShowLineNumberSet = true
		cfg.Column = true
		cfg.WithFilename = true
		cfg.WithFilenameSet = true
	case "no-vimgrep":
	case "context-separator", "no-context-separator":
		_ = value
	case "line-buffered", "block-buffered", "no-line-buffered", "no-block-buffered":
	case "auto-hybrid-regex":
	case "no-pcre2-unicode":
	case "pretty":
		cfg.Color = "ansi"
		cfg.ColorSet = true
		cfg.Heading = 1
		cfg.ShowLineNumber = true
		cfg.ShowLineNumberSet = true
	case "hostname-bin":
		_ = value
	case "no-config":
		cfg.NoConfig = true
	case "generate":
		_ = value
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("unrecognized flag --%s", name)
	case "stop-on-nonmatch":
	case "include-zero":
	case "replace":
		_ = value
	default:
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("unrecognized flag --%s", name)
	}
	return consumed, nil
}

func longFlagNeedsValue(name string) bool {
	switch name {
	case "regexp", "file", "max-count", "after-context", "before-context", "context",
		"max-depth", "max-filesize", "glob", "iglob", "type", "type-not",
		"type-add", "type-clear", "sort", "sortr", "field-match-separator",
		"field-context-separator", "path-separator", "engine", "threads",
		"encoding", "pre", "pre-glob", "replace", "dfa-size-limit",
		"regex-size-limit", "ignore-file", "color", "colors", "context-separator",
		"hostname-bin", "generate":
		return true
	}
	return false
}

func longFlagAllowsOptionalValue(name string) bool {
	return false
}

// parseSizeLike accepts "1234" only for now.
func parseSizeLike(s string) (int64, error) {
	n, err := strconv.ParseInt(s, 10, 64)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("invalid value: %q", s)
	}
	return n, nil
}

package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
)

type Config struct {

	CaseInsensitive bool
	CaseSensitive   bool
	SmartCase       bool
	InvertMatch     bool
	WordRegexp      bool
	LineRegexp      bool
	FixedStrings    bool
	MaxCount        int64
	HasMaxCount     bool
	Multiline       bool
	MultilineDotall bool

	ShowLineNumber bool
	ShowLineNumberSet bool
	HideLineNumber bool

	WithFilename  bool
	WithFilenameSet bool
	NoFilename    bool

	Count         bool
	CountMatches  bool
	FilesWithMatches bool
	FilesWithoutMatch bool
	OnlyMatching  bool
	Quiet         bool
	Heading       int // -1=off, 0=auto, 1=on
	Column        bool
	ByteOffset    bool
	NoMessages    bool

	AfterContext  int
	BeforeContext int

	Color         string // auto, always, never, ansi
	ColorSet      bool

	Hidden        bool
	NoIgnore      bool
	Unrestricted  int

	FollowLinks   bool
	MaxDepth      int
	HasMaxDepth   bool
	Glob          []string
	IGlob         []string
	GlobCaseInsensitive bool

	Sort          string
	SortR         string

	// field separator
	FieldMatchSeparator string
	FieldContextSeparator string
	PathSeparator       string

	// PCRE2 flag  
	PCRE2 bool
	Engine string

	NullData bool
	CRLF bool
	NoUnicode bool

	Encoding string

	// Output
	Pretty bool // synonym for color=ansi + heading + line-num

	ThreadsN int

	Trim bool

	Debug bool

	Stats bool

	Null bool

	Json bool

	NoConfig bool
}

func newConfig() *Config {
	return &Config{
		Heading: 0,
		AfterContext: 0,
		BeforeContext: 0,
		Color: "auto",
		MaxDepth: -1,
		FieldMatchSeparator: ":",
		FieldContextSeparator: "-",
	}
}

type flagDef struct {
	short    string
	long     string
	takesArg bool
	noArg    bool // true = boolean flag that takes no arg at all
}

// parseArgs parses command-line arguments.
func parseArgs(args []string) (*Config, error) {
	cfg := newConfig()

	// Detect -V (short version)
	// --help vs -h: long help for --help, short for -h
	cfg.LongHelp = false

	positional := []string{}
	// manual parser to handle complex ripgrep flag parsing
	i := 0
	onlyPos := false
	for i < len(args) {
		a := args[i]
		if onlyPos {
			positional = append(positional, a)
			i++
			continue
		}
		if a == "--" {
			onlyPos = true
			i++
			continue
		}
		if a == "-" || !strings.HasPrefix(a, "-") {
			positional = append(positional, a)
			i++
			continue
		}
		// flag
		if strings.HasPrefix(a, "--") {
			// long flag
			name := a[2:]
			var value string
			hasVal := false
			if eq := strings.Index(name, "="); eq >= 0 {
				value = name[eq+1:]
				name = name[:eq]
				hasVal = true
			}
			consumed, err := handleLongFlag(cfg, name, value, hasVal, args, i)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			i += consumed
		} else {
			// short flag(s) - can be combined like -in
			rest := a[1:]
			// Handle combined short flags
			j := 0
			advance := 1
			for j < len(rest) {
				c := rest[j]
				flagName := string(c)
				// Check if this flag takes a value
				needsValue, ok := shortFlagNeedsValue(flagName)
				if !ok {
					return nil, fmt.Errorf("unrecognized flag -%s", flagName)
				}
				if needsValue {
					var value string
					hasVal := false
					if j+1 < len(rest) {
						value = rest[j+1:]
						hasVal = true
						j = len(rest)
					} else if i+1 < len(args) {
						value = args[i+1]
						hasVal = true
						advance = 2
					}
					if !hasVal {
						return nil, fmt.Errorf("the -%s flag requires a value", flagName)
					}
					if err := handleShortFlag(cfg, flagName, value, true); err != nil {
						return nil, err
					}
					break
				} else {
					if err := handleShortFlag(cfg, flagName, "", false); err != nil {
						return nil, err
					}
					j++
				}
			}
			i += advance
		}
	}

	// post-process positional
	if cfg.ShowHelp || cfg.ShowVersion || cfg.TypeList {
		return cfg, nil
	}

	if cfg.Files {
		cfg.Paths = positional
		return cfg, nil
	}

	if len(cfg.Patterns) == 0 && len(cfg.PatternFiles) == 0 {
		if len(positional) > 0 {
			cfg.PatternFromArg = positional[0]
			cfg.Patterns = append(cfg.Patterns, positional[0])
			positional = positional[1:]
		}
	}
	cfg.Paths = positional

	return cfg, nil
}

func shortFlagNeedsValue(flag string) (bool, bool) {
	switch flag {
	case "h", "V", "i", "s", "S", "v", "w", "x", "F", "n", "N", "c", "l", "L", "o", "q", "H", "a", "z", "p", "P", "u", ".", "I":
		return false, true
	case "e", "f", "g", "m", "t", "T", "A", "B", "C", "M", "E", "d", "j", "r":
		return true, true
	}
	return false, false
}

func handleShortFlag(cfg *Config, name, value string, hasVal bool) error {
	switch name {
	case "h":
		cfg.ShowHelp = true
		cfg.LongHelp = false
	case "V":
		cfg.ShowVersion = true
		globalVerboseVersion = false
	case "i":

	case "s":
		cfg.CaseSensitive = true
	case "S":
		cfg.SmartCase = true
	case "v":
		cfg.InvertMatch = true
	case "w":
		cfg.WordRegexp = true
	case "x":
		cfg.LineRegexp = true
	case "F":
		cfg.FixedStrings = true
	case "n":
		cfg.ShowLineNumber = true
		cfg.ShowLineNumberSet = true
		cfg.HideLineNumber = false
	case "N":
		cfg.HideLineNumber = true
		cfg.ShowLineNumber = false
		cfg.ShowLineNumberSet = true
	case "c":
		cfg.Count = true
	case "l":
		cfg.FilesWithMatches = true
	case "L":
		cfg.FilesWithoutMatch = true
	case "o":
		cfg.OnlyMatching = true
	case "q":
		cfg.Quiet = true
	case "H":
		cfg.WithFilename = true
		cfg.WithFilenameSet = true
		cfg.NoFilename = false
	case "a":
		// binary as text
	case "z":
		// search-zip
	case "p":
		// pretty
		cfg.Color = "ansi"
		cfg.ColorSet = true
		cfg.Heading = 1
		cfg.ShowLineNumber = true
		cfg.ShowLineNumberSet = true
	case "P":
		cfg.PCRE2 = true
		return fmt.Errorf("PCRE2 is not available in this build of ripgrep")
	case "u":
		cfg.Unrestricted++
	case ".":
		cfg.Hidden = true
	case "I":
		cfg.NoFilename = true

// handleLongFlag returns number of args consumed (1 or 2).
func handleLongFlag(cfg *Config, name, value string, hasVal bool, args []string, i int) (int, error) {
	need := longFlagNeedsValue(name)
	if need {
		if !hasVal {
			if i+1 < len(args) {
				value = args[i+1]
				hasVal = true
			} else {
				return 0, fmt.Errorf("the --%s flag requires a value", name)
			}
		}
	} else {
		if hasVal {
			// Some flags allow --flag=value optionally; else error
			if !longFlagAllowsOptionalValue(name) {
				// Some flags accept boolean value like --color=never
			}
		}
	}

	consumed := 1
	if need && !strings.Contains(args[i], "=") {
		consumed = 2
	}

	switch name {
	case "help":
		cfg.ShowHelp = true
		cfg.LongHelp = true
	case "version":
		cfg.ShowVersion = true
		globalVerboseVersion = true
	case "regexp":
		cfg.Patterns = append(cfg.Patterns, value)
	case "file":
		cfg.PatternFiles = append(cfg.PatternFiles, value)
	case "ignore-case":
		cfg.CaseInsensitive = true
	case "case-sensitive":
		cfg.CaseSensitive = true
		cfg.CaseInsensitive = false
		cfg.SmartCase = false
	case "smart-case":
		cfg.SmartCase = true
	case "invert-match":
		cfg.InvertMatch = true
	case "word-regexp":
		cfg.WordRegexp = true
	case "line-regexp":
		cfg.LineRegexp = true
	case "fixed-strings":
		cfg.FixedStrings = true
	case "no-fixed-strings":
		cfg.FixedStrings = false
	case "max-count":
		n, err := parseSizeLike(value)
		if err != nil {
			return 0, fmt.Errorf("--max-count: %v", err)
		}
		cfg.MaxCount = n
		cfg.HasMaxCount = true
	case "line-number":
		cfg.ShowLineNumber = true
		cfg.ShowLineNumberSet = true
	case "no-line-number":
		cfg.ShowLineNumber = false
		cfg.HideLineNumber = true
		cfg.ShowLineNumberSet = true
	case "with-filename":
		cfg.WithFilename = true
		cfg.WithFilenameSet = true
	case "no-filename":
		cfg.NoFilename = true
		cfg.WithFilename = false
		cfg.WithFilenameSet = true
	case "count":
		cfg.Count = true
		cfg.CountMatches = false
	case "count-matches":
		cfg.CountMatches = true
		cfg.Count = true
	case "files-with-matches":
		cfg.FilesWithMatches = true
	case "files-without-match":
		cfg.FilesWithoutMatch = true
	case "only-matching":
		cfg.OnlyMatching = true
	case "quiet":
		cfg.Quiet = true
	case "heading":
		cfg.Heading = 1
	case "no-heading":
		cfg.Heading = -1
	case "column":
		cfg.Column = true
		cfg.ShowLineNumber = true
		cfg.ShowLineNumberSet = true
	case "no-column":
		cfg.Column = false
	case "byte-offset":
		cfg.ByteOffset = true
	case "no-messages":
		cfg.NoMessages = true
	case "messages":
		cfg.NoMessages = false
	case "after-context":
		n, err := strconv.Atoi(value)
		if err != nil || n < 0 {
			return 0, fmt.Errorf("--after-context: invalid value: %q", value)
		}
		cfg.AfterContext = n
	case "before-context":
		n, err := strconv.Atoi(value)
		if err != nil || n < 0 {
			return 0, fmt.Errorf("--before-context: invalid value: %q", value)
		}
		cfg.BeforeContext = n
	case "context":
		n, err := strconv.Atoi(value)
		if err != nil || n < 0 {
			return 0, fmt.Errorf("--context: invalid value: %q", value)
		}
		cfg.AfterContext = n
		cfg.BeforeContext = n
	case "color":
		switch value {
		case "never", "auto", "always", "ansi":
			cfg.Color = value
			cfg.ColorSet = true

			return 0, fmt.Errorf("--color: invalid value: %q", value)
		}
	case "colors":
		// complex - ignore
	case "hidden":
		cfg.Hidden = true
	case "no-hidden":
		cfg.Hidden = false
	case "follow":
		cfg.FollowLinks = true
	case "no-follow":
		cfg.FollowLinks = false
	case "max-depth":
		n, err := strconv.Atoi(value)
		if err != nil || n < 0 {
			return 0, fmt.Errorf("--max-depth: invalid value: %q", value)
		}
		cfg.MaxDepth = n
		cfg.HasMaxDepth = true
	case "max-filesize":
		// accept but ignore
	case "no-ignore":
		cfg.NoIgnore = true
	case "ignore":
		cfg.NoIgnore = false
	case "no-ignore-vcs", "no-ignore-global", "no-ignore-parent",
		"no-ignore-dot", "no-ignore-exclude", "no-ignore-files",
		"no-require-git", "no-ignore-messages":
		// accept
	case "glob":
		cfg.Glob = append(cfg.Glob, value)
	case "iglob":

	case "glob-case-insensitive":
		cfg.GlobCaseInsensitive = true
	case "type", "type-not", "type-add", "type-clear":
		_ = value
	case "type-list":
		cfg.TypeList = true
	case "files":
		cfg.Files = true
	case "sort":
		cfg.Sort = value
	case "sortr":
		cfg.SortR = value
	case "field-match-separator":
		cfg.FieldMatchSeparator = value
	case "field-context-separator":
		cfg.FieldContextSeparator = value
	case "path-separator":
		cfg.PathSeparator = value
	case "pcre2":

	case "no-pcre2":
		cfg.PCRE2 = false
	case "engine":
		cfg.Engine = value
		if value == "pcre2" {
			return 0, fmt.Errorf("PCRE2 is not available in this build of ripgrep")
		}
	case "threads":
		n, err := strconv.Atoi(value)
		if err != nil || n < 0 {
			return 0, fmt.Errorf("--threads: invalid value: %q", value)
		}
		cfg.ThreadsN = n
	case "null-data":
		cfg.NullData = true
	case "crlf":
		cfg.CRLF = true
	case "no-crlf":
		cfg.CRLF = false
	case "no-unicode":
		cfg.NoUnicode = true
	case "unicode":
		cfg.NoUnicode = false
	case "encoding":
		cfg.Encoding = value
	case "no-encoding":
		cfg.Encoding = ""
	case "multiline":
		cfg.Multiline = true
	case "no-multiline":
		cfg.Multiline = false
	case "multiline-dotall":
		cfg.MultilineDotall = true
	case "no-multiline-dotall":
		cfg.MultilineDotall = false
	case "text":
		// treat binary as text
	case "binary":
		// search binary
	case "no-binary":
	case "mmap", "no-mmap":
	case "pre", "pre-glob":
		_ = value
	case "no-pre":
	case "search-zip", "no-search-zip":
	case "one-file-system", "no-one-file-system":
	case "unrestricted":
		cfg.Unrestricted++
	case "debug", "no-debug":
		cfg.Debug = true
	case "trace":
		cfg.Debug = true
	case "stats", "no-stats":
		cfg.Stats = true
	case "dfa-size-limit", "regex-size-limit":
		_ = value
	case "null":
		cfg.Null = true
	case "json":
		cfg.Json = true
	case "no-json":
		cfg.Json = false
	case "ignore-file":
		_ = value
	case "ignore-file-case-insensitive":
	case "no-ignore-file-case-insensitive":
	case "trim", "no-trim":
		cfg.Trim = true
	case "vimgrep":
		cfg.Heading = -1
		cfg.ShowLineNumber = true
		cfg.ShowLineNumberSet = true
		cfg.Column = true
		cfg.WithFilename = true
		cfg.WithFilenameSet = true
	case "no-vimgrep":
	case "context-separator", "no-context-separator":
		_ = value
	case "line-buffered", "block-buffered", "no-line-buffered", "no-block-buffered":
	case "auto-hybrid-regex":
	case "no-pcre2-unicode":
	case "pretty":
		cfg.Color = "ansi"
		cfg.ColorSet = true
		cfg.Heading = 1
		cfg.ShowLineNumber = true
		cfg.ShowLineNumberSet = true
	case "hostname-bin":
		_ = value
	case "no-config":
		cfg.NoConfig = true
	case "generate":
		_ = value
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("unrecognized flag --%s", name)
	case "stop-on-nonmatch":
	case "include-zero":
	case "replace":
		_ = value
	default:
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("unrecognized flag --%s", name)
	}
	return consumed, nil
}

func longFlagNeedsValue(name string) bool {
	switch name {
	case "regexp", "file", "max-count", "after-context", "before-context", "context",
		"max-depth", "max-filesize", "glob", "iglob", "type", "type-not",
		"type-add", "type-clear", "sort", "sortr", "field-match-separator",
		"field-context-separator", "path-separator", "engine", "threads",
		"encoding", "pre", "pre-glob", "replace", "dfa-size-limit",
		"regex-size-limit", "ignore-file", "color", "colors", "context-separator",
		"hostname-bin", "generate":
		return true
	}
	return false
}

func longFlagAllowsOptionalValue(name string) bool {
	return false
}

// parseSizeLike accepts "1234" only for now.
func parseSizeLike(s string) (int64, error) {
	n, err := strconv.ParseInt(s, 10, 64)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("invalid value: %q", s)
	}
	return n, nil
}
